l2_reporting_sch.factaccountsnapshot_final as fasf on dr.riskkey = fasf.riskkey and dr.periodid=fasf.reportingperiodkey GROUP BY  FILTERREPORTINGPERIOD,    dr.riskscorethiscycledescription;
PROMPT: Show distribution of accounts by risk score range.

QUERY:
SELECT
  l.Risk_Category AS "Product Tier",
  dd.month_name || ' ' || CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.Full_Date) AS VARCHAR) AS "DATE",
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.Loan_Key) AS "Total Loans",
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.Loan_Key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Missed Repayments",
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.Loan_Key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.Loan_Key), 0),
    2
  ) AS "Missed Percentage"
FROM l2_loans_sch.FACT_DISBURSEMENT d
JOIN l2_loans_sch.DIM_LOAN_MASTER_2 l ON d.Loan_Key = l.Loan_Key
JOIN l2_loans_sch.dim_date dd ON dd.date_key = d.date_key
CROSS JOIN l2_loans_sch.business_date bd
LEFT JOIN l2_loans_sch.FACT_REPAYMENT r 
  ON d.Loan_Key = r.Loan_Key AND r.Is_First_Repayment = TRUE
WHERE dd.Full_Date BETWEEN DATEADD(month, -6, TO_DATE(bd.bd_id::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) 
                      AND TO_DATE(bd.bd_id::text, 'YYYYMMDD')
GROUP BY 
  l.Risk_Category, 
  dd.month_name, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.Full_Date)
ORDER BY 
  MIN(dd.Full_Date) ASC,
  l.Risk_Category;
PROMPT: What is the percentage of new residential home loans that missed their first repayment in the last six months, broken down by core product tiers like Prime, Near Prime, and Specialist?
